flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui App.tsx (route fr commented out), pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchForm,form/NoticeSearchOutstandingForm,form/NoticeSearchAllForm,list/NoticeSearchOutstandingList,hook/useBatchOperation}. ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_management/retrieval/getnotice (plus-offence-notice), workflows/payment_reduction/reduction (plus-apply-reduction). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no reduction search code
note: Status in stories.json: 'Requirement given - Gen flow' (no flow deck; Sesuai = the code does what the story text says). The story asks for a search of outstanding notices to reduce. The staff portal has a general 'Outstanding Notices' search (route /notices/search/outstanding), but the Fine Reduction page (Epic16 FR) is commented out in App.tsx and reduction only enters through the PLUS endpoint /v1/plus-apply-reduction. Whether PLUS has its own reduction search screen: cannot verify from repo. No maintenance ticket touches the search.
recommendation: Claim partially: a general outstanding search exists and lists notices, but it is not a reduction-specific search function. Ask URA whether the reduction search is done in PLUS (outside the repo).

steps.step: Officer opens the search for outstanding notices to reduce
steps.detail: The staff portal has a Notice Search page with an 'Outstanding Notices' option (NoticeSearchForm.tsx:131, route App.tsx:106), but it is a general search also used by TS/PS/revival/CPS, not a reduction-specific search. The Fine Reduction page (Epic16 FR: routes fr, fr/view, fr/verification) sits inside a comment block at App.tsx:171-176 and the Epic16 import is commented out too (App.tsx:50); the batch operation types have no FR (useBatchOperation.ts:19-27). Reduction can only enter through POST /v1/plus-apply-reduction called by PLUS (ReductionController.java:29). Whether a reduction search screen exists in PLUS: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Officer searches by standard parameters notice number and ID number
steps.detail: The Outstanding form has ID No., Offender Name, Vehicle No. and offence/court date ranges (NoticeSearchOutstandingForm.tsx:41,57,67,85) but no Notice No. field; Notice No. exists only in the All Notices form (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:64). On the API side, /v1/plus-offence-notice accepts free filters including idNo through getAllWithOwnerInfo (GetNoticeServiceImpl.java:48-61, OcmsValidOffenceNoticeServiceImpl.java:352), but whether PLUS uses it for a reduction screen: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Officer searches by standard parameter current processing stage
steps.detail: The Processing Stage filter exists only in the All Notices form (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:297). In the Outstanding search the stage only appears as a result column (NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:160), not as a search parameter. The /v1/plus-offence-notice response includes lastProcessingStage (NoticeResponseMapper.java:71), but that is output, not proof of a stage search screen for reduction.

steps.step: OCMS shows the searched notices on screen
steps.detail: NoticeSearchOutstandingList renders a Datagrid from the validoffencenoticelist resource with a default outstanding filter (suspensionType TS/blank/null, or PS with exception codes, offenderIndicator Y; NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:105-124), sorted by newest notice date, with columns stage, notice no., rule code, vehicle no., offence place, date, amount payable, offender, court date (NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:137-139,160-182). The list is general and does not filter on reduction eligibility (rule code + stage are only checked at apply time).
